about: v2: open verifier notes for part03 (P03-C4 Mad Sprite circles the dead oak)

entries.why: the Mad Sprite stood still beside the dead oak; period trainer text says he circles it non-stop: a closed 8-point loop of radius 200 round the client's Dead Tree fixture (zone 200 #979, local 12032,28928), all points on walkable navmesh ground, no swimming, no guards near
